description: Derive the project filesystem paths when only a subset of the logical names is supplied (each remaining name falling back to its built-in default), when the application root is deeply nested, and when a non-default active environment selects a different configuration section. Verifies that the fixed location of the path-configuration document is independent of any overridden configuration directory.
